## What's new in 0.9.6

A reliability release for the **Code agent** — the engine behind Code, Create, Auto, and Orchestrate.

### Orchestrate mode

- **Sub-agent transcripts actually load.** Clicking a finished sub-agent could show "This sub-agent hasn't produced anything yet" even when it had run and written files. Conversations other than the newest are stored as lightweight stubs and only the *active* one was ever hydrated — and a sub-agent is never the active chat, so nothing loaded it.
- **The transcript no longer runs off the bottom of the screen,** and it is now *always* fully in view. The panel and the sub-agent list share the card's height, so with many sub-agents the list scrolls instead of pushing the transcript off-screen.
- **Sub-agent names are readable.** Tasks used to truncate to "Fix orchestra…" / "Fix conversa…", which made several sub-agents indistinguishable. The list is one full-width row per sub-agent now, with the tree redrawn as a spine with status-colored branches.
- **The sub-agent model picker shows effort levels for local models again** (it resolved them from an empty model list, so the selector was missing entirely).
- **Settings → "always use the orchestrator model" now takes effect** without a restart.

### Code agent

- **Faster streaming, less input lag.** The live token counter was doing work proportional to the whole conversation on *every* token — re-serializing every file the agent had written, per token.
- **No more stuck "running tool" spinners.** Four kinds of tool call (web search, MCP tools, AGENTS.md lookups, and file reads/writes) left the indicator spinning forever if the tool threw.
- **Follow-up task chips use the model you're actually on**, not whichever one was selected when the app launched.
- **The context gauge stays accurate** after a chat creates, merges, or leaves a worktree.

### Under the hood

- The engine was split from one 5,900-line file into focused modules (public types, tool schemas, pure turn helpers, and the git-worktree lifecycle), and ~2,500 lines of dead code left over from an earlier Create implementation were removed.
- Cloud config reads are now import-safe, which unlocked unit tests for a swath of the library. New test coverage for the agent's tool-advertising rules across all 256 mode/flag combinations, plus the turn helpers.

No action needed — open installs will offer the update automatically.
